name: Agent Image Attachments Demo
tagline: Upload local image paths and inspect them through native agent.session attachments.
description: A throwaway integration prototype for native Agent Session image inputs. Enter up to six absolute local image paths. A bundled Python Executa reads those files and persists them with host/uploadFile using purpose=image_input. The app receives short-lived HTTPS URLs and passes them directly to agent.session.run({content, attachments}). The streamed session frames and model response are rendered as an in-memory log. This intentionally avoids upload_local_file and analyze_image so the test isolates native multimodal input.
